quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 1,805,033 million (+5.0%), operating income JPY 67.1 billion (-21.1%), ordinary profit JPY 75.7 billion (-15.5%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 64.8 billion (-28.1%); Non-GAAP operating income JPY 94.1 billion (-3.5%), Non-GAAP net income JPY 71.2 billion (+5.9%). Operating margin fell to 3.7% from 4.9%; management states the main factor was the move of Tekscend Photomask to an equity-method affiliate from the second half of the year. Segments (sales / operating income): Information & Communication JPY 923.2 billion (-0.2%) / JPY 45.0 billion (-1.1%); Living & Industry JPY 723.0 billion (+31.4%) / JPY 33.0 billion (-1.1%); Electronics JPY 186.3 billion (-34.2%) / JPY 33.6 billion (-36.5%). Sales by customer location: Japan JPY 1,074,657 million, Asia JPY 292,188 million, North America JPY 247,371 million, other regions JPY 190,816 million. No customer accounts for 10% or more of net sales.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 1,805,033 million (+5.0%); operating income JPY 67.1 billion (-21.1%); Electronics sales JPY 186.3 billion (-34.2%)

quarterly_data.signal: Electronics, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report, management's analysis): in semiconductors, FC-BGA high-density package substrates obtained multiple qualifications for advanced products and demand for communications uses increased; Toppan built a new production line at its Niigata Plant, its FC-BGA production base, to handle large, high-layer-count high-end products for advanced semiconductors, and it has started operating; it is setting up a pilot line for next-generation semiconductor packages at the Ishikawa Plant, its new technology-development and mass-production base, and joined the Japan-US consortium US-JOINT to build an evaluation platform for next-generation semiconductor packages in the US. Segment sales fell because Tekscend Photomask became an equity-method affiliate, but rose excluding that effect. Display sales fell on customers' inventory adjustment of anti-reflection film and the move of Giantplus Technology to an equity-method affiliate. Electronics production JPY 187,836 million (-32.6%); segment total assets JPY 266.9 billion (-16.0%).
quarterly_data.figure: Electronics production JPY 187,836 million (-32.6%); new high-end FC-BGA line at Niigata Plant operating

Production JPY 1,807,679 million (+5.3%).
quarterly_data.figure: Order backlog JPY 341,434 million (-16.6%); Electronics backlog JPY 150,596 million (-28.0%)

quarterly_data.signal: Medium-Term Management Plan 2028 (annual securities report): targets for the company's fiscal 2028 (the year ending March 2029), the plan's final year, are operating income JPY 130.0 billion, ROE 8%, Non-GAAP operating income JPY 145.0 billion and Non-GAAP ROE 9%; for its fiscal 2031 (the year ending March 2032) the company aims at operating income JPY 200.0 billion, ROE 10%, Non-GAAP operating income JPY 210.0 billion and Non-GAAP ROE 11.5%. In Electronics, management states it will concentrate resources on the semiconductor package business, including next-generation packages, to achieve high profitability and high growth there, citing the long-term growth of the semiconductor market, and will restructure low-profit businesses.
quarterly_data.figure: Company's fiscal 2028 targets: operating income JPY 130.0 billion, ROE 8%; fiscal 2031: operating income JPY 200.0 billion, ROE 10%

quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report, including intangibles): JPY 119.7 billion - Electronics JPY 33.7 billion to expand FC-BGA high-density package substrate production, where demand is rising with the growth of the AI market, and to install the next-generation semiconductor package R&D pilot line; Living & Industry JPY 46.3 billion (a new flexible-packaging film plant in Japan, SX packaging equipment, global packaging and decorative-material supply); Information & Communication JPY 25.6 billion; corporate JPY 14.0 billion. Planned: Tamapoly's Gunma Reiwa Plant (provisional name; Oura District, Gunma), film manufacturing equipment, land and buildings, total JPY 25,291 million, JPY 13,154 million already paid, started December 2024, completion October 2026. No significant disposals are planned.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex JPY 119.7 billion (Electronics JPY 33.7 billion); Gunma Reiwa Plant JPY 25,291 million, completion October 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Electronics R&D (annual securities report): as package substrates grow larger and chiplets advance, interposer technology based on large glass substrates is expected as an alternative to today's mainstream silicon interposers, which have difficulty scaling up; Toppan installed a pilot line for next-generation semiconductor package R&D at the Ishikawa Plant and aims to start operating it from July 2026. Its organic RDL interposer development on this line was selected for NEDO's Post-5G information and communication systems program (advanced semiconductor manufacturing technology, subsidised). TOPPAN will accelerate manufacturing-technology development of glass cores, glass interposers and organic RDL interposers, aiming at high-capacity data transmission with lower power consumption. Group R&D expense for the year JPY 26,788 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Ishikawa pilot line to start operating from July 2026; group R&D JPY 26,788 million

quarterly_data.signal: Other R&D, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): TOPPAN Digital (now TOPPAN) implemented post-quantum cryptography (PQC) in its Edge Safe secure element and its Secure Activate Service, protecting IoT devices from authentication through communication; TOPPAN began verifying an LLM-based next-generation automatic simultaneous interpretation system; TOPPAN Edge (now TOPPAN) was certified as Japan's first vLEI issuer and its vLEI service was adopted for a working-group trial on site certification in the semiconductor supply chain; a transmissive decorative film for solar panels targets mass production during the company's fiscal 2026 (the year ending March 2027); Toppan and OOYOO developed mass-production technology for a CO2 separation membrane, began a joint demonstration (100 kg/day) in October 2025 and aim to start the business by 2030.
